stories.title: ERKLÄRT - Kunsthaus-Subventionen, Politikerlöhne, Sterbehilfe und Hochhäuser: Darüber stimmen die Zürcher am 27. September ab

en.title: EXPLAINED - Art museum subsidies, politician salaries, assisted dying and high-rises: Zurich voters decide on these on 27 September
en.summary: Zurich residents will vote on four major ballot measures on 27 September, including funding for an art museum, government salaries, end-of-life provisions, and residential high-rise development.

stories.title: MELDUNGEN POLIZEI - Zoll deckt Netzwerk von Lebensmittelschmugglern auf +++ Bus kollidiert in Oerlikon mit Lieferwagen – fünf Passagiere verletzt

en.title: POLICE REPORTS - Customs uncovers food smuggling network +++ Bus collides with delivery van in Oerlikon – five passengers injured
en.summary: Swiss authorities dismantled a food smuggling operation while a separate incident saw a bus collide with a delivery vehicle in Zurich, injuring five passengers.

stories.title: E-Banking und App – Zeitweilige Störungen bei Postfinance behoben

en.title: E-Banking and App – Temporary disruptions at Postfinance resolved
en.summary: Postfinance experienced technical issues with its mobile application and online banking services during the morning, which were subsequently fixed.

stories.title: Hohe Mieten – Bundesrat will missbräuchliche Mietzinsen stärker bekämpfen

en.title: High Rents – Federal Government Wants to Combat Abusive Rental Prices More Strongly
en.summary: The Swiss Federal Government rejected a rental price initiative but plans to develop an indirect counter-proposal to address excessive rent increases.

stories.title: Wie sich der Star-Goalie Reto Berra mit dem Wechsel nach Kloten im Spätherbst der Karriere einen Kindheitstraum erfüllt

en.title: How star goalie Reto Berra fulfills a childhood dream with his move to Kloten in the autumn of his career
en.summary: Reto Berra, a longtime national team goalkeeper, has joined EHC Kloten and is providing stability to the young team. The move represents a potential breakthrough season for the club.

stories.title: Angriffe auf Ölterminal – Was nützt Saudi-Arabien Frankreichs Hilfe gegen die Huthi?

en.title: Attacks on oil terminal – What does France's help against the Houthis benefit Saudi Arabia?
en.summary: Saudi Arabia faces pressure from Houthi militia attacks on oil infrastructure. France has announced support to assist the kingdom against these attacks.

stories.title: Architektur für die Kunst – Peter Zumthor schafft Klarheit: Neue Bauten fürs Beyeler-Museum

en.title: Architecture for art – Peter Zumthor creates clarity: New buildings for the Beyeler Museum
en.summary: Architect Peter Zumthor has designed an expansion for the Fondation Beyeler that separates museum functions into three independent structures.

stories.title: L'essayiste français Samuel Fitoussi affirme être derrière le compte «Balance ton Claude», à l'origine de l'affaire Thélyson Orélien

en.title: French essayist Samuel Fitoussi claims to be behind the "Balance ton Claude" account, at the origin of the Thélyson Orélien affair
en.summary: Samuel Fitoussi, a French essayist, stated he is part of a collective project behind an anonymous account that accused writer Thélyson Orélien of using artificial intelligence to write his novel.

stories.title: L'essayiste Samuel Fitoussi dit être derrière les accusations de recours à l'IA de Thélyson Orélien

en.title: Essayist Samuel Fitoussi says he is behind accusations of AI use against Thélyson Orélien
en.summary: Samuel Fitoussi claims to be part of a collective project running an anonymous account that accused Canadian-Haitian writer Thélyson Orélien of using artificial intelligence to write a novel that won a literary prize.

stories.title: Un incendie se déclare dans une usine de matériaux isolants à Lucens

en.title: Fire breaks out at insulation materials factory in Lucens
en.summary: A fire occurred overnight at an insulation materials manufacturing facility in Lucens, resulting in no injuries or pollution release. Firefighters have brought the fire under control.

stories.title: Un incendie s’est déclaré dans une usine à Lucens, aucun blessé à déplorer

en.title: Fire breaks out at factory in Lucens, no injuries reported
en.summary: A fire occurred overnight at an insulation materials factory in Lucens. The fire is under control with no injuries, though the public is advised to avoid the area and traffic is severely disrupted.

stories.title: Peter Zumthor signe la nouvelle extension de la Fondation Beyeler à Bâle

en.title: Architect Peter Zumthor designs new extension for Beyeler Foundation in Basel
en.summary: The Beyeler Foundation museum near Basel is expanding with a new building designed by architect Peter Zumthor. A previously private park is now open to the public, doubling the site's area.

stories.title: Einer Million VW-Autos in Deutschland droht Lenkungsausfall

en.title: One Million VW Cars in Germany Face Steering Failure Risk
en.summary: A screw defect in several VW and Audi models could cause steering system failure. The German automotive authority has issued guidance on affected vehicles.

stories.title: INTERVIEW - Deutscher Politiker fordert harte China-Zölle: «Wir verfüttern den Mittelstand und hoffen, dass wenige Grossunternehmen als Letztes gefressen werden»

en.title: INTERVIEW - German politician calls for tough China tariffs: "We're feeding the middle class to the wolves and hoping a few large corporations are the last to be eaten"
en.summary: A rising CDU talent argues that Europe must adopt protectionist trade policies against Chinese overcapacity to prevent continental deindustrialization.

stories.title: Die EU geht gegen grünen Etikettenschwindel vor – und sorgt auch bei Schweizer Textilfirmen für grosse Verunsicherung

en.title: The EU cracks down on green marketing deception – causing major uncertainty among Swiss textile firms
en.summary: The EU will ban misleading environmental claims in clothing marketing starting late September, creating concerns that stricter rules might paradoxically reduce overall sustainability efforts.

stories.title: «Europa ist die Nummer vier» – die USA holen die Nato-Partner auf den Boden der Realität

en.title: "Europe is number four" – the USA brings NATO allies back to reality
en.summary: The American NATO ambassador emphasizes Europe's diminished global significance, while research suggests Europeans cannot defend themselves without US support before 2030.

stories.title: Rivalität zwischen China und den USA: Der Welthandel ist stärker regionalisiert, als es sein Name impliziert

en.title: Rivalry Between China and the USA: Global Trade is More Regionally Concentrated Than Its Name Suggests
en.summary: Trade patterns have become increasingly geographically concentrated, a trend intensified by trade tensions between the US and China. The US and Switzerland are notable exceptions to this regionalization.
